acknowledged.thm:uniform-deterministic-guard: Delivered headline result. The accepted claim mandates the explicit deterministic-guard confidence set whose containment of the entire identified interval tends to one uniformly under overlap and a uniform aggregate survivor-mass bound; it is a terminal contribution, so having no downstream consumer is expected.
acknowledged.def:uniform-law-class: Supporting definition for thm:uniform-deterministic-guard: it fixes the uniform law class over which the guard's containment is claimed. Legitimate because its only consumer is an acknowledged headline.
acknowledged.thm:linear-sparse-threshold-flow: Delivered contribution. The accepted claim mandates the O(|X|K) sparse-flow algorithm with O(|X|K^2) dense materialization; it is an algorithmic deliverable and terminal in the proof spine.
acknowledged.prop:three-level-witness: Delivered witness the accepted claim mandates verbatim: survivor share 1/2, higher-arm mixture (0.2,0.5,0.3), lower-arm marginal (0.3,0.4,0.3), sharp benefit interval [0,0.7]. It certifies that the interval is attained and non-degenerate, so it is a claimed benchmark, not motivation.
acknowledged.def:three-level-witness: Supporting definition for prop:three-level-witness: it fixes the numeric instance the accepted claim names. Legitimate because its only consumer is an acknowledged deliverable.
acknowledged.thm:no-selection-reduction: Sanity-reduction benchmark: it shows the bounds collapse to the known no-selection submodel behaviour, which is the sanctioned boundary/reduction result rather than motivation-only standard material. Deleting it would remove a claimed consistency check, not simplify a proof.
